 THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF THE MOTOR VEHICLES ACT PRAYING TO SET ASIDE THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 10.08.2021 IN ECA NO.2/2017 PASSED BY THE COURT OF SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND COMMISSIONER FOR EMPLOYEE'S COMPENSATION AT HUMNABAD AND CONSEQUENTLY ALLOW THE PRESENT APPEAL THEREBY AWARDING COMPENSATION RS.15,00,000/-
AS CLAIMED IN THE PRESENT APPEAL.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Learned counsel for the appellants has filed a memo seeking permission to withdraw the appeal.
In view of the same, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
